# Clearing account: clearing-account (CLR)

An account at a CCP holding cleared trades and margin. One row per clearing account per business date, keyed by ACCOUNT_ID. Read by the **core** pack's connector `reference-store` (table `<root>/reference/clearing-account/`). Delivered **daily**, 60 business days (2026-07-08 to 2026-09-30): the first day's file is a **full snapshot** (5 records); each later day's file holds only the records new or changed that day (2–2 a day). Drishti applies a day's file by key over the day before: a record absent from a day's file keeps its previous version, and nothing is ever deleted (an end is a changed status). 123 rows in all.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `data/testdata/core/clearing-account/` + `changes-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz`, `snapshot-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line, gzip-compressed (`.jsonl.gz`) |
| Key field | `ACCOUNT_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the business date is the file's date (`snapshot-` or `changes-YYYY-MM-DD`), which becomes the lake's partition `business_date` |
| Promoted columns | none (the whole record is kept as `doc`) |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | a full snapshot on the first day, then only the changed records |

## Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ACCOUNT_ID` | string | required | The record's id (the business key) | pattern `^CLR-` | `"CLR-CME-1"` |
| `CCP_NAME` | string | required | The name of the CCP the account is held at (the CCP's NAME). | one of `CME Clearing`, `Eurex Clearing AG`, `ICE Clear Europe`, `Japan Securities Clearing Corp.`, `LCH Ltd` | `"CME Clearing"` |
| `IM` | integer | required | The initial margin posted on the account, in the bank's reporting currency (USD in the demo). | seen: `20400000`, `43200000`, `15600000`, `30600000`, `7200000`; unit: USD | `43200000` |
| `VM_TODAY` | integer | required | Today's variation margin on the account: the sum of its cleared trades' one-day P&L, in the bank's reporting currency (USD in the demo); negative is paid by the bank. | seen: `-15597445`, `-16067620`, `0`; unit: USD | `-15597445` |
| `EXCESS` | integer | required | The collateral held at the CCP above the margin required, in the bank's reporting currency (USD in the demo). | seen: `4080000`, `8640000`, `1440000`, `3120000`, `6120000`; unit: USD | `8640000` |
| `TRADES` | array of objects | required (filled in 98% of rows) | The trades cleared through the account, at most thirty: one object per trade. | — | [30 objects] |
| `TRADES[].TRADE_ID` | string | required | The cleared trade: a TRADE_ID of the trading pack's trade kind (text). | pattern `^((MX\|CLY)-)?\d+$`; links to `trade` | `"MX-20000067"` |
| `TRADES[].STATUS` | string | required | The trade's life-cycle status (NEW, VALIDATED, AMENDED,...), upper case. | seen: `AMENDED`, `VALIDATED`, `LIVE` | `"VALIDATED"` |
| `TRADES[].PRODUCT` | string | required | The trade's product name. | — | `"Short-term interest rate future"` |
| `TRADES[].ASSET_CLASS` | string | required | The trade's asset class (Rates, Equity, Commodity, Fixed income,...). | one of `Commodity`, `Equity`, `Fixed income`, `Rates` | `"Rates"` |
| `TRADES[].CURRENCY` | string | required | The trade's currency, ISO 4217. | one of `AUD`, `CAD`, `CHF`, `EUR`, `GBP`, `JPY`, `USD` | `"GBP"` |
| `TRADES[].BOOK` | string | required | The trade's book: a BOOK_ID of the core pack's book kind (BOOK-…). | pattern `^BOOK-`; links to `book` | `"BOOK-RATES-2"` |
| `TRADES[].NOTIONAL` | number | required | The trade's notional, in the trade's own currency. | unit: trade currency | `221100000.0` |
| `TRADES[].MATURITY` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The trade's maturity date. | — | `"2027-05-21"` |
| `TRADES[].MATURITY_BUCKET` | string | required | The remaining maturity bucket of the trade: 0-1Y, 1-2Y, 2-5Y, 5-10Y or 10Y+. | one of `0-1Y`, `1-2Y`, `10Y+`, `2-5Y`, `5-10Y` | `"0-1Y"` |
| `TRADES[].MTM` | integer | required | The trade's MTM, in the bank's reporting currency (USD in the demo). | unit: USD | `252935` |
| `CCP` | string | required | The CCP the account is held at: a CCP_ID of the core pack's ccp kind (CCP-…). | pattern `^CCP-`; links to `ccp` | `"CCP-CME"` |

## Fields in other rows

None: all 123 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `ACCOUNT_ID` per `business_date`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `ACCOUNT_ID`, `CCP_NAME`, `IM`, `VM_TODAY`, `EXCESS`, `TRADES`, `CCP` (the contract's required fields).
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Each day: the records new or changed that day (or all of them); Drishti keeps the rest from the day before.
- Unique: `ACCOUNT_ID` per business_date.
- `ACCOUNT_ID` matches `^CLR-`.
